answer: Fake identities fail here on a time test, not a headcount: a trellis of attestations is only trusted when each rung was earned in a different past epoch, so a terrace of shells minted in one night has no depth to show. To fake that depth an attacker must keep every shell live and attested across many epochs at full price, while a dune of cheap accounts still shifts under any node that checks the spacing of their history.
